title: 第二十一章 苦修阵成第二十二章 神通九天圣莲华

三招之下，他司马傲便输给了一个刚刚凝聚魄月的洗凡英魄境初期修士，这样的事情若非真的发生在自己的身上，司马傲根本不可能去相信。
虽然心中不甘，但司马傲不得不承认，三招之下，自己输的很彻底，林无缺赢得很彻底。
就在司马傲脸色灰暗的想要爬起身来时，一只白皙有力的手掌向他伸来，正是林无缺。
抬起头，司马傲看向眼前这个三招就将他击败的对手，迎上了后者充满真挚的眼神，一咬牙，司马傲握住了林无缺的手，借力从地上站起身来。
站定的司马傲眼神内闪烁着不甘、震惊、无奈……最终化为一股深深的叹服，对着林无缺沉声开口：“林无缺，你很强，输给你，我司马傲心服口服。你放心，袭龙战阵龙首由你来当，林璎珞做龙身，龙尾就交给我。百城大战中，我司马傲服从你所有的命令，绝不会添任何乱。”
字字如钉，司马傲这番话发自内心，没有一丝一毫的虚假。
齐世龙暗暗点点头，这就是司马傲的性格，此子虽然自负，向来不把同辈人放在眼中，自视甚高，而且信奉实力就是规矩，可一旦被同辈人以堂堂正正的手段正面击败，便会心服口服，坦坦荡荡，你比我强，我听你的又何妨？
这也是齐世龙选择此子代表龙光的原因，而司马傲的这一点也被林无缺洞悉，所以才会有三招之约。他就是要先让司马傲输的心服口服，接着主动示好，如此先是震慑再是怀柔，洞悉司马傲性格的林无缺怎会不成功？
心中一阵满意，齐世龙知道三人之间最大的问题已经被林无缺彻底解决，接下来，便是抓紧一切时间好好修炼袭龙战阵了。
林璎珞尽管心中一直相信林无缺会赢，却没有想到林无缺在三招之内就击败了司马傲，而且还赢得如此干脆。司马傲的实力比起她，也不过在伯仲之间，换句话说，林无缺同样可以三招就击败自己。
三招击败司马傲，林无缺也大致明白了自己现在的战力如何。
“我的圣道战气品质比之一般的元力本就强出许多，无论是凝练度和杀伤力都是一半元力的十倍，如今修为上来了，圣道战气战力全开的话，现在的我足以横跨一个大阶位轻易击败洗凡精魄境初期的修士；如果再加上开启斗战圣法本源的加持，那么精魄境中期的修士或许都可以一战！”
越阶而战，便是林无缺最大的倚仗。
接下来，三人便开始了对袭龙战阵的学习和修炼，毕竟，三人要想在二十天左右的时间内将此战阵修炼成功，做到三位一体，配合默契，共同进退，也不算简单。
还好，三人如今放下了所有的成见，全心全意的投入到学习当中。
三日之后，青凝广场。
林无缺，林璎珞，司马傲三人以一个玄奥的站姿各自占据一个方位，隐隐可看出是以林无缺为首，林璎珞为中枢，司马傲为策应。
“袭龙走位！”

林无缺一声低喝，随即林璎珞和司马傲眼神一凝，快速的以林无缺为中心，交叉走位，而林无缺则眼观六路耳听八方，调动身体的每一个部分，随着林璎珞、司马傲的走位，始终保持能够随时接应。
“阵起！袭龙行！”
眼神交汇，林无缺为首，林璎珞紧随其后，司马傲脚踏八方，三人瞬间气势一变！
在齐世龙的眼中，三人连成一线，隐隐形成一条十丈大小的龙形光幕，林无缺为龙首，林璎珞为龙身，司马傲为龙尾！
轻轻点头，这三日，林无缺三人一直苦苦钻研袭龙战阵阵图，相互交流，力求将所有走位变化牢记在心，烂熟无比。
今日，终于开始了正式修炼，三人果然不愧都是天才，第一次便能做到阵起，虽然还略显生涩，但已经极不简单，尤其是林无缺，此子调度十方，尽管林璎珞和司马傲走位时有着些许的偏差，他都能及时补上使得袭龙走位成功。
“看来此子在战阵一途上也有着极高的天赋！可惜现在存世的大多是合击战阵，那些以一人之力便可布下的超级战阵早已经失传……”
“嗷”
一道若有若无的龙吟之声响起，这道龙吟充满深沉和暗灭，仿佛突然在你耳边响起，带来无边的杀机！
袭，本就是突然攻击的意思。
袭龙战阵，讲究的便是以迅雷不及掩耳之势凝聚所有力量瞬间攻杀敌人的战阵，出其不意，攻其不备。
“咚咚咚”
三人步伐齐齐前行，林无缺双手放于腰部两侧，眼神扫视十方，完全进入攻击状态，林璎珞全力维持林无缺与司马傲之间的走位，她本就善于观察，一些细微的偏差立刻就可以察觉出来，保持三人的平衡；司马傲最为灵活，他的意识散开，随时注意来自后方的各种危险，将其反馈给林璎珞。
“袭龙探爪！”
随着林无缺一声大喝，三人的脸上俱都肃穆起来，修为全开，林璎珞和司马傲以一种来自袭龙战阵阵图上特殊的方式将修为输送给林无缺！
“嗡”
林无缺浑身大亮，收于腰部两侧的双拳向前轰出，仿佛一条巨龙挥出龙爪，爆发出强大的攻击！
“咚”
淡金色的光芒闪耀，这一击重重的轰在了青凝石板之上，回响起惊人的声音！
但就在发出这一击之后，三人所形成的袭龙战阵瞬间便崩塌开来，无法再度维持。

In just three moves, he, Sima Ao, lost to a monk in the early stages of the Xi Moran Heroic Soul Realm who had just condensed the Soul Moon. If such a thing had not really happened to him, Sima Ao would never have believed it.
Although he was unwilling to give up, Sima Ao had to admit that in three moves, he lost completely and Lin Wuque won completely.
Just when Sima Ao was about to get up with a gloomy face, a white and strong palm stretched out to him, it was Lin Wuque.
Raising his head, Sima Ao looked at the opponent in front of him who defeated him in three moves, and met the latter's sincere eyes. Gritting his teeth, Sima Ao took Lin Wuque's hand and used his strength to stand up from the ground.
The eyes of Sima Ao who stood still flashed with unwillingness, shock, and helplessness... and finally turned into a deep admiration, and he said in a deep voice to Lin Wuque: "Lin Wuque, you are very strong, and I, Sima Ao, am convinced if I lose to you. Don't worry, you will be the head of the dragon attack formation, Lin Yingluo will be the dragon body, and the tail will be left to me. In the Hundred Cities Battle, I, Sima Ao, will obey all your orders and will never cause any trouble."
Every word is like a nail, Sima Ao's words come from the heart, there is no trace of falsehood.
Qi Shilong secretly nodded, this is Sima Ao's character. Although this son is conceited, he has never put his peers in the eyes, he thinks highly of himself, and he believes that strength is the rule. But once he is defeated head-on by his peers in an upright way, he will be convinced and candid. You are better than me, so why should I listen to you?
This is also the reason why Qi Shilong chose this son to represent Long Guang, and this point about Sima Ao was also understood by Lin Wuque, so there was a three-move agreement. He just wanted to convince Sima Ao first, and then take the initiative to show his kindness. In this way, he would first shock and then be gentle. How could Lin Wuque, who knew Sima Ao's character well, not succeed?
Feeling satisfied in his heart, Qi Shilong knew that the biggest problem between the three of them had been completely solved by Lin Wuque. Next, he would seize all the time to practice the Dragon Attack Formation.
Although Lin Yingluo always believed that Lin Wuque would win, she did not expect that Lin Wuque defeated Sima Ao within three moves and won so easily. Compared to her, Sima Ao's strength was only between the two. In other words, Lin Wuque could also defeat him in three moves.
After defeating Sima Ao in three moves, Lin Wuque also roughly understood his current combat power.
"The quality of my holy battle energy is much stronger than that of ordinary Yuanli. Both the concentration and the lethality are ten times that of half Yuanli. Now that my cultivation has improved, if the holy battle energy is fully activated, I can easily defeat the monks in the early stages of the Pure Soul Realm across a large level. If I add the blessing of the source of the Holy Law of Fighting, then the monks in the middle stage of the Soul Realm may be able to fight!"
Fighting across the ranks is Lin Wuque's greatest reliance.
Next, the three of them began to study and practice the Dragon Attack Formation. After all, it is not easy for the three of them to successfully practice this formation in about twenty days and achieve trinity, cooperate with each other, and advance and retreat together.
Fortunately, the three of them have now put aside all their prejudices and devoted themselves wholeheartedly to their studies.
Three days later, Qingning Square.
Lin Wuque, Lin Yingluo, and Sima Ao each occupied a position in a mysterious stance. It was vaguely visible that Lin Wuque was the leader, Lin Yingluo was the center, and Sima Ao was the supporter.
"The attacking dragon moves!"
Lin Wuque shouted low, and then Lin Yingluo and Sima Ao stared at each other, and quickly moved around with Lin Wuque as the center, while Lin Wuque watched and listened in all directions, mobilizing every part of his body to follow Lin Yingluo and Sima Ao's movements, always being able to respond at any time.
"Array up! Attack the dragon!"
Their eyes met, Lin Wuque took the lead, Lin Yingluo followed closely behind, Sima Ao stepped in all directions, and the momentum of the three of them suddenly changed!
TogetherIn Shilong's eyes, the three people were connected in a line, forming a faint dragon-shaped light curtain ten feet in size. Lin Wuque was the dragon's head, Lin Yingluo was the dragon's body, and Sima Ao was the dragon's tail!
Nodding lightly, Lin Wuque and the others have been studying the dragon attack formation diagrams for the past three days, communicating with each other, trying to keep all the changes in positions in mind, and become extremely familiar with them.
Today, the formal training finally started. The three of them are indeed geniuses. They were able to do the formation for the first time. Although it was still a little awkward, it was already very easy. Especially Lin Wuque, who coordinated the movements of the ten directions. Even though there were some deviations in the movements of Lin Yingluo and Sima Ao, he was able to make up for them in time to make the dragon attack successful.
"It seems that this boy also has a very high talent in battle formations! Unfortunately, most of the existing battle formations are combined attack battle formations. Those super battle formations that can be set up by one person have long been lost..."
"Ouch"
A faint sound of dragon roar sounded. This dragon roar was full of depth and darkness, as if it suddenly sounded in your ears, bringing boundless murderous intent!
Attack means a sudden attack.
The essence of the dragon attack formation is to gather all the power with lightning speed to instantly attack and kill the enemy, taking them by surprise and attacking them unprepared.
"Dong dong dong"
The three of them walked forward in unison. Lin Wuque put his hands on both sides of his waist, his eyes scanned in all directions, and he was completely in attack mode. Lin Yingluo tried his best to maintain the position between Lin Wuque and Sima Ao. She was good at observing, and she could detect some slight deviations immediately to maintain the balance of the three. Sima Ao was the most flexible, his consciousness was spread out, he was always aware of various dangers from behind, and fed back to Lin Yingluo.
"Assault on the dragon's claws!"
As Lin Wuque shouted loudly, the faces of the three of them became solemn, and their cultivation levels were fully activated. Lin Yingluo and Sima Ao transferred their cultivation levels to Lin Wuque in a special way from the attack dragon battle formation diagram!
"Buzz"
Lin Wuque's whole body was bright, and his fists on both sides of his waist were thrust forward, as if a giant dragon was waving its claws, bursting out with a powerful attack!
"Boom"
Pale golden light shone, and the blow hit the Qingning stone slab hard, echoing with an astonishing sound!
But just after sending this blow, the dragon attack formation formed by the three people instantly collapsed and could no longer be maintained.
